sources.note: ODbL ADSBiq aircraft-diff observations from 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-06, using the public 2026-08 and 2026-09 release assets. Only exact active-alliance callsigns observed during this recent window are considered; observation alone does not provide an airport pair. Missing upstream daily assets: 2026-08-30.
CC0 standing-data exact callsign-to-route mapping. A route is retained only when the exact callsign was actually observed in the Aug 1-Sep 6 ADSBiq window.
Public search-index sitemap additionally confirms each retained physical pair remains in the current scheduled-passenger route index (65,052 directional pairs).
